content: Out of Time Timelord . Series .  Kirk Marcan has spent his life in the DOD black operations as a test pilot, in fact he has flown some of the most state-of-the-art secrets this country has produced, but now he is being asked to do something no man has ever done, time travel .  During the initial test an accident fuses him with a compound that allows a human to navigate the time streams.  Using this technology, he tries to go back and fix his own broken childhood and instead returns to a world bleak and devastated. Now he must go back and try and repair the damage he has caused.    Kirk can now travel through time at will It has an effect on his body, the more he does it the more it takes its toll, sooner or later he will not come back or simply stop existing.  .  Kirk Marcan Captain in the Air Force He is a cocky test pilot with the ability to travel through time .  He learns a very valuable lesson in trying to change time  He see’s echoes of something coming  He is not alone and learns there are others who can also travel .  .
